body.prompt: The same nest on the tall tree, much later in the night: the mother magpie is almost completely covered by a thick white cap of snow, only her face and wing edges showing, eyes half closed, still holding her wings wide over the nest. Far below, most of the hanok village windows have gone dark; only a few lights remain. Snow still falling, quiet and cold.
